name: bluetooth-pedometer
description: Ultra-low-power CC2340R5 Bluetooth pedometer built with tscircuit

scripts.build: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --all-images --pcb-png --schematic-png --autorouter-timeout 15m && tsci check shorts dist/index/circuit.json
scripts.snapshot:update: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --routing-disabled --pcb-png && tsci snapshot index.circuit.tsx --update
